property_summary: For any successfully filled position NFT, once an authorized caller transfers it to a recipient, that recipient remains able to transfer the token onward; the mutant keeps `_ownerOf` pointing at the old owner, so the recorded recipient loses authorization and its onward transfer reverts.

For any input, a successful transferFrom(from,to,id) implies that from was the true owner of token id immediately before the call (transfers from non-owners revert and never change _ownerOf); the mutant removes the WRONG_FROM check, so a caller can pass an arbitrary from and successfully reassign ownership of an unminted id, violating the rule.

An unminted token id can never become owned: any transferFrom on an id with zero address owner must revert and leave it unminted; the mutant drops the WRONG_FROM check so a caller passing from==msg.sender successfully mints ownership of an unminted id.

In the reference contract, transferFrom to address(0) always reverts (INVALID_RECIPIENT), so no token can ever be transferred to the zero address; the mutant removes that check and lets the transfer succeed, so for a minted position the call to address(0) completes instead of reverting.
